# Bagseven

> Infrastructure for autonomous AI agents. Humans mint a public, expiring entitlement. Agents spend under a mandate. Money settles on Hedera. Unique humans via World. MCP is the product.

## Start

pnpm setup
pnpm start:local

Landing http://localhost:3001
Dashboard http://localhost:3000/app  (magic-link login)
Gateway :4000  Daemon :4001  Policy :4003

## What this repo is

Monorepo (pnpm + turbo). Two product surfaces only:

- apps/landing — Fianto-style marketing
- apps/console — Fianto-style operator dashboard (/app)

Backend: services/gateway, services/daemon, services/policy
Libraries: packages/entitlements, packages/world, packages/notify, packages/db, packages/money, packages/onchain, packages/server

## Dual-gate (IP)

Payment clock = Hedera (payment_tx)
Renewal clock = grant.renewal_enabled (cancel does not kill paid_through)
Access clock = Arkiv grant remaining + TTL — queryable object, not a private /check API

paid_run / bagseven_fetch require mandate remaining AND living grant (BAGSEVEN_REQUIRE_GRANT=true).

## Auth

Cookie bagseven_session (HMAC, 8h). Magic link is a signed 15-minute token. POST /api/auth/magic → Resend (or dev_hint). GET /api/auth/callback?token= sets the cookie on the redirect.

Default: any email. Optional AUTH_ALLOWLIST.

## Email (Resend)

From bags@cesthq.com. Magic link to the typed address. Grant events to signed-in user + optional OPERATOR_NOTIFY_EMAIL.
Events: magic_link, grant_minted, credits_bought, world_denied, paid_run, renewal_cancelled.

## MCP tools

bagseven_status, grant_status, mint_with_world, buy_credits, paid_run, cancel_renewal, explain_denial, bagseven_fetch
Bind one worker: BAGSEVEN_MCP_WORKER=<uuid> pnpm mcp:local

## Tracks (mock vs live)

World: WORLD_MOCK_PROOFS vs WORLD_CLIENT_ID
Hedera: HEDERA_DEMO_SETTLE vs facilitator / real tx
Arkiv: ENTITLEMENT_STORE=memory vs ARKIV_ACCESS_KEY + ARKIV_PRIVATE_KEY

## Design

docs/design.md — --blue #0002f8, landing dark hero, dashboard #f2f2f2 sidebar, rounded 16px cards. Do not put marketing header on the dashboard.

## Do not

- Add a third web app or port 3010 inspector
- Put operator keys in client JS
- Weaken fail-closed policy / spend_token (docs/DECISIONS.md)
- Add extra UIs or leftover demo apps
